div.div: كُوزٌ A kind of vessel, (TA,) well-known, (A, K,) [namely, a mug, or drinking-cup,] with a handle: (IAar, TA:) AHn says, that it is a Persian word; but ISd denies this, and asserts it to be genuine Arabic: it is said to be from كَازَ “ he collected: ” (TA:) pl. [of pauc.] أَكْوَازٌ, and [of mult.] كِيزَانٌ and كِوَزَةٌ. (S, K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
